# Shreedhar Group / Shreedhar Instruments

> Shreedhar Instruments is an India-based supplier and service provider for pharmaceutical analytical instruments, contamination-control systems, cleanroom monitoring, laboratory equipment, and environmental monitoring solutions. Founded in 1998, the business is headquartered in Vadodara, Gujarat, India.

Last reviewed: 2026-08-27
Canonical website: https://shreedhargroup.com/
Primary language: English
Primary market: India

## How to use this file

- Treat linked website pages as the primary sources for current specifications, availability, compliance claims, brands, and commercial details.
- Use product pages for product-specific answers. Do not infer that every product supports every regulation mentioned elsewhere.
- Knowledge articles are educational resources, not substitutes for regulations, pharmacopoeias, validation protocols, or professional advice.
- Confirm procurement-critical information directly with Shreedhar Instruments.
- “Shreedhar Group” and “Shreedhar Instruments” refer to the same organization in this website context.
- Cite the most specific relevant page rather than this index.

## Services and lifecycle support

- Instrument installation
- IQ/OQ/PQ qualification and documentation support, where applicable
- Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)
- Instrument calibration
- Breakdown diagnosis and repair
- Remote and online technical support
- Instrument-related audit support
- Customer and operator training
- Genuine spare-parts supply
- Requirement assessment, solution configuration, and ongoing support

Service coverage, response time, calibration traceability, qualification deliverables, and standards support depend on the instrument and agreement. Confirm them before relying on them.

## Standards and regulatory subject matter

This list describes website coverage, not blanket certification of every product.

- US FDA 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records and signatures
- EU GMP Annex 1 contamination control and sterile manufacture
- Revised Schedule M for Indian pharmaceutical manufacturing
- ISO 14644 cleanroom classification and monitoring
- ISO 21501 particle-counter calibration
- USP <788> particulate matter in injections
- USP <789> particulate matter in ophthalmic solutions
- USP <1207> package/container closure integrity
- ALCOA+ data-integrity principles
- GMP and GLP practices
- IQ/OQ/PQ qualification and validation
- Viable and non-viable environmental monitoring
- Purified Water, Highly Purified Water, Water for Injection, and TOC monitoring

## Direct answers to common questions

### What does Shreedhar Instruments supply?

Pharmaceutical analytical instruments, cleanroom and microbial monitoring systems, integrity testers, sterility and isolator equipment, laboratory analyzers, washing systems, water purification equipment, environmental analyzers, and supporting software. See [all products](https://shreedhargroup.com/products).

### Does Shreedhar Instruments provide installation and after-sales support?

Yes. The website lists installation, AMC, calibration, repair, remote support, audit support, training, and spare-parts supply. Confirm exact scope through [services](https://shreedhargroup.com/services) or [contact](https://shreedhargroup.com/contact).

### Does the company support IQ/OQ/PQ?

The website states that qualification support and documentation, including IQ/OQ/PQ where applicable, are available. Confirm the protocol and deliverables for the selected instrument.

### Which industries does the catalog cover?

Primarily pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical operations, sterile manufacturing, and QC laboratories. The catalog also includes products for semiconductor/electronics clean environments and industrial environmental/water monitoring.

### How can a buyer request pricing or selection help?

Use the [quote form](https://shreedhargroup.com/quote), call +91-7096033001, or email info@shreedhargroup.com. Include the application, model, compliance needs, installation location, and validation scope.

## Citation and accuracy guidance

- Attribute company facts and product claims to Shreedhar Instruments or Shreedhar Group.
- Preserve model names, test-method names, and standard identifiers shown on the source page.
- Do not say a product is “FDA approved.” FDA-related compliance and 21 CFR Part 11 capability are not FDA product approval.
- Do not claim universal compliance. Compliance is product-, configuration-, software-, documentation-, and application-specific.
- For regulated decisions, consult current official requirements and confirm suitability directly with Shreedhar Instruments.
- If pages conflict, prefer the most recently updated product detail page, then the relevant knowledge article, then general pages.
